title: The explicit degreewise total-cone comparison
statement: Let I be a preorder and A a preadditive category with binary biproducts, and coproducts in the universes of I and Nat. For D,E:I→CochainComplex(A,Int) and φ:D→E, let totalArrow be the induced map of total bars [def-sc-preorder-bar-total]. In every integer degree, the total bar of the objectwise cone diagram [def-sc-preorder-bar-cone-diagram] is explicitly isomorphic to mappingCone(totalArrow).

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: On a cone summand in bar degree p and internal degree q, send its source summand to the source of the cone of totalArrow with coefficient (-1)^p, and send its target summand to the target with coefficient 1. Use the corresponding diagonal inclusions. Define the inverse by totalDesc on source and target with the same coefficients. The cone projections define these maps without existence choices. Test composites on both cone inclusions and every bar generator. They reduce to identity because ((-1)^p)^2=1. This constructs coneTotalXIso in each degree.
